newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dollar ends steady in active trade.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dollar ends steady in active trade.

text.p: The Taiwan dollar ended stable against its U.S. counterpart in active trade on Friday amid a lack of market-moving factors, dealers said.
The local unit closed at T$27.637 against Thursday's T$27.640 close, off an intra-day high of T$27.626 when the U.S. dollar went softer overseas, dealers said.
Turnover through dealers was US$259.5 million.

"The market was relatively quiet. At one time, there was a brief demand of the local unit by foreign stock investors, thus pulling up the Taiwan dollar," said one dealer. A T$27.62-64 range was seen for Saturday. -- Lawrence Chung (5080815)
